author: _Noe
body: Hello, I'm NoeNava or Raeliff (old account name). It has been nearly a month since i have been banned from the server, reason being for Excessive Infractions. There is no way that my bans were false. They were all very much true and done by myself, i take responsibility for them. I know for a fact that i have learned the lesson in the ban i received. If my ban gets lifted i will be sure to return with full respect to players and mods. If i am unbanned from the server i will be sure to be respectful to the mods and players what they have to say. I know its not a reason to be unbanned but its the best thing i have to offer in this position. I do take this server very seriously. I have invested money in it. I would greatly appreciate it if this appeal is read and very much appreciate it if i were to get unbanned. I apologize for the trouble and inconvenience i have caused the server. If this request gets accepted or denied i will respect the answer either way. Until then. Happy gaming.
